company.shortDescription: Lucira Health is a biotechnology company that offers disposable test kits to detect RNA and DNA of infectious diseases.
company.description: Lucira Health is a medical technology company focused on the development and commercialization of transformative and innovative infectious disease test kits. Lucira has developed a testing platform that produces centralized-laboratory-accurate molecular testing in a single-use and consumer-friendly test kit that is powered by two AA batteries and fits in the palm of a hand.
